headword: {運転|うんてん}{代行|だいこう}

definitions.gloss: designated driver service; chauffeur service for drunk drivers
definitions.explanation: A service in Japan where a professional driver drives your car home for you when you have been drinking. Two drivers come — one drives your car and the other follows in a company car.

examples.japanese: {運転|うんてん}{代行|だいこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}んだ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: I called a designated driver service.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飲|の}み{会|かい}→飲み会：09371_nomikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧あと{運転|うんてん}{代行|だいこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}んだ→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: I requested a designated driver service after the drinking party.

examples.japanese: {運転|うんてん}{代行|だいこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}すれば→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}れる→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: If you use a designated driver service, you can get home safely in your own car.

notes:
USAGE:
A service unique to Japan where two professional drivers come to your location — one drives your car home while the other follows in a company vehicle. Very common after ⟦{飲|の}み{会|かい}→飲み会：09371_nomikai⟧ (drinking parties), especially in areas without convenient public transportation. Often shortened to ⟦{代行|だいこう}→代行：11433_daikou⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {運転|うんてん}{代行|だいこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧ (to call a designated driver service)
- {運転|うんてん}{代行|だいこう}{業者|ぎょうしゃ} (designated driver service company)
- ⟦{代行|だいこう}→代行：11433_daikou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧ (to request a driver service — shortened form)
